import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

root = Path('/home/domen/dev/casita3')
out = root / 'benchmarks/results/2026-09-08-statement-cache'
target = root / 'target'
provenance = {}
for variant in ('baseline', 'candidate'):
    source = Path(f'/tmp/casita-statement-cache-{variant}-20260908')
    revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(source), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
    if variant in ('baseline', 'candidate'):
        command = ['cargo', 'build', '--release', '--locked', '--features', 'cli', '--bin', 'casita',
                   '--manifest-path', str(source / 'Cargo.toml'), '--target-dir', str(target)]
        print(' '.join(command), flush=True)
        with (out / f'{variant}-cli-build.log').open('w') as log:
            subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    shutil.copy2(target / 'release/casita', out / f'{variant}-casita')
    sqlite = source / 'src/metadata/sqlite.rs'
    text = sqlite.read_text()
    assert text.endswith('}\n')
    sqlite.write_text(text[:-2] + (out / 'collection-probe.rs').read_text() + '}\n')
    command = ['cargo', 'test', '--release', '--locked', '--features', 'cli', '--lib', '--no-run',
               '--message-format=json', '--manifest-path', str(source / 'Cargo.toml'), '--target-dir', str(target)]
    print(' '.join(command), flush=True)
    with (out / f'{variant}-probe-build.jsonl').open('w') as stdout, (out / f'{variant}-probe-build.log').open('w') as stderr:
        subprocess.run(command, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=True)
    artifacts = [json.loads(line) for line in (out / f'{variant}-probe-build.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
    executables = [a['executable'] for a in artifacts if a.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact' and a.get('executable') and a['target']['name'] == 'casita']
    assert len(executables) == 1, executables
    shutil.copy2(executables[0], out / f'{variant}-probe')
    provenance[variant] = {'revision': revision, 'source': str(source), 'features': 'cli', 'profile': 'release',
        'sqlite_sha256': hashlib.sha256(sqlite.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'lock_sha256': hashlib.sha256((source / 'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'artifacts': {kind: {'path': str(out / f'{variant}-{kind}'),
          'sha256': hashlib.sha256((out / f'{variant}-{kind}').read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for kind in ('casita', 'probe')}}
    (out / 'binaries.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Builds complete', flush=True)

run.py.content:
"""Run paired, serial measurements using retained release artifacts."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path('/home/domen/dev/casita3')
out = root / 'benchmarks/results/2026-09-08-statement-cache'
provenance = json.loads((out / 'binaries.json').read_text())
receipts = []
receipt_path = out / 'execution.json'
if receipt_path.exists():
    receipts = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())

for round_number in range(1, 4):
    order = ('baseline', 'candidate') if round_number % 2 else ('candidate', 'baseline')
    for suite in ('collection', 'repository', 'graph', 'generations', 'history', 'publication'):
        for variant in order:
            name = f'{round_number}-{suite}-{variant}'
            if any(r['name'] == name and r.get('status') == 'passed' for r in receipts):
                continue
            cli = str(out / f'{variant}-casita')
            probe = str(out / f'{variant}-probe')
            result = out / f'{name}.json'
            base = [sys.executable, '-m', 'benchmarks.cli', 'run']
            if suite == 'collection':
                command = [probe, 'metadata::sqlite::tests::benchmark_statement_cache_collection', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture']
            elif suite == 'repository':
                command = base + ['repository', '--profile', 'standard', '--corpora', 'small-files,mixed',
                    '--operations', 'collect,unchanged-import,edited-import-in-place', '--implementations', 'casita',
                    '--cache-policies', 'warm', '--repetitions', '1', '--no-build', '--casita-bin', cli,
                    '--casita-revision', provenance[variant]['revision'], '--output', str(result), '--report', str(result.with_suffix('.md'))]
            elif suite == 'graph':
                command = base + ['graph-traversal', '--casita', cli, '--profile', 'standard',
                    '--spill-thresholds', '1024,250000', '--repetitions', '1', '--output', str(result)]
            elif suite == 'generations':
                command = base + ['generations', '--casita-bin', cli, '--profile', 'standard',
                    '--generations', '10', '--repetitions', '1', '--output', str(result)]
            elif suite == 'history':
                command = base + ['history-scale', '--no-build', '--probe-binary', probe,
                    '--generations', '100,1000,10000', '--window', '100', '--repetitions', '1', '--output', str(result)]
            else:
                command = base + ['state-publication', '--probe-binary', probe, '--iterations', '300',
                    '--writers', '4', '--repetitions', '1', '--output', str(result)]
            entry = {'name': name, 'round': round_number, 'suite': suite, 'variant': variant,
                'revision': provenance[variant]['revision'], 'command': command,
                'started_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(), 'load_before': os.getloadavg()}
            print(f"START {name}", flush=True)
            start = time.monotonic()
            try:
                with (out / f'{name}.log').open('w') as log:
                    if suite == 'collection':
                        entry['collection_settings'] = [{'count': 256, 'warm_iterations': 50}, {'count': 65537, 'warm_iterations': 2}]
                        for setting in entry['collection_settings']:
                            env = {**os.environ, 'CASITA_COLLECTION_COUNTS': str(setting['count']),
                                'CASITA_COLLECTION_ITERATIONS': str(setting['warm_iterations'])}
                            subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=1200)
                    else:
                        subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=1200)
                if suite == 'collection':
                    output = (out / f'{name}.log').read_text()
                    assert output.count('1 passed') == 2, output
                    samples = [json.loads(line.removeprefix('collection_sample ')) for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith('collection_sample ')]
                    assert [s['count'] for s in samples] == [256, 65537]
                    result.write_text(json.dumps({'samples': samples}, indent=2) + '\n')
                data = json.loads(result.read_text())
                kind = 'probe' if suite in ('collection', 'history', 'publication') else 'casita'
                data['comparison_artifact'] = {'variant': variant, 'revision': provenance[variant]['revision'],
                    **provenance[variant]['artifacts'][kind]}
                result.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
                entry['result_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(result.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                entry['status'] = 'passed'
            except Exception as error:
                entry.update(status='failed', error=str(error))
            entry.update(elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - start, load_after=os.getloadavg())
            receipts.append(entry)
            receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipts, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(f"{entry['status'].upper()} {name} ({entry['elapsed_seconds']:.1f}s)", flush=True)
print('Measurements complete', flush=True)
if any(r['status'] != 'passed' for r in receipts):
    sys.exit(1)

summarize.py.content:
import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics

root = Path('/home/domen/dev/casita3')
out = root / 'benchmarks/results/2026-09-08-statement-cache'
execution = json.loads((out / 'execution.json').read_text())
assert len(execution) == 36 and all(r['status'] == 'passed' for r in execution)
groups = collections.defaultdict(lambda: {'baseline': [], 'candidate': []})
samples_count = 0
raw = {}
for run in execution:
    result = json.loads((out / (run['name'] + '.json')).read_text())
    raw[run['name']] = result
    samples = result['samples']
    assert len(samples) == {'collection': 2, 'repository': 6, 'graph': 4,
        'generations': 20, 'history': 6, 'publication': 1}[run['suite']]
    if run['suite'] != 'collection':
        assert all(s['status'] == 'ok' for s in samples)
    samples_count += len(samples)
    local = collections.defaultdict(list)
    def add(label, millis):
        local[(run['suite'], label)].append(millis)
    for s in samples:
        if run['suite'] == 'collection':
            for warm in (False, True):
                values = [v['nanos'] / 1e6 for v in s['samples'] if v['warm'] == warm]
                add(f"{s['count']:,} objects, {'warm median' if warm else 'first collection'}", statistics.median(values))
        elif run['suite'] == 'repository':
            add(f"{s['corpus']} / {s['operation']}", s['wall_seconds'] * 1000)
        elif run['suite'] == 'graph':
            assert bool(s['spill_files_opened']) == (s['spill_memory_objects'] == 1024)
            add(f"{s['operation']} / threshold {s['spill_memory_objects']:,}", s['wall_seconds'] * 1000)
        elif run['suite'] == 'generations':
            add(s['operation'], s['wall_seconds'] * 1000)
        elif run['suite'] == 'history':
            if s['operation'] == 'tiny-delta-publication':
                add(f"{s['generations']:,} roots / update", s['p50_nanos'] / 1e6)
                for phase in ('state_commit', 'payload_prepare'):
                    add(f"{s['generations']:,} roots / {phase}", statistics.median(u['publication_phases'][phase]['nanos'] for u in s['updates']) / 1e6)
            else:
                add(f"{s['generations']:,} roots / reopen", s['wall_seconds'] * 1000)
        else:
            for key, value in s['metrics'].items():
                if key.endswith('_nanos'):
                    add(key, value / 1e6)
    for key, values in local.items():
        groups[key][run['variant']].append({'round': run['round'], 'milliseconds': statistics.median(values)})

boundary = json.loads((out / 'boundary.json').read_text())
assert len(boundary) == 6 and all(s['status'] == 'passed' for s in boundary)
for run in boundary:
    assert run['sample']['count'] == 65536
    assert len(run['sample']['samples']) == 3
    for warm in (False, True):
        values = [s['nanos'] / 1e6 for s in run['sample']['samples'] if s['warm'] == warm]
        label = f"65,536 objects, {'warm median' if warm else 'first collection'}"
        groups[('boundary', label)][run['variant']].append({'round': run['repetition'], 'milliseconds': statistics.median(values)})

confirmation = json.loads((out / 'confirmation.json').read_text())
assert len(confirmation) == 10 and all(r['status'] == 'passed' for r in confirmation)
for run in confirmation:
    assert len(run['result']['samples']) == 2
    for sample in run['result']['samples']:
        assert sample['status'] == 'ok'
        for metric, millis in [('wall', sample['wall_seconds'] * 1000),
                              ('CPU', (sample['user_seconds'] + sample['system_seconds']) * 1000)]:
            label = f"small-files / {sample['operation']} / {metric}"
            groups[('confirmation', label)][run['variant']].append({'round': run['repetition'], 'milliseconds': millis})

rows = []
graph_confirmation = json.loads((out / 'graph-confirmation.json').read_text())
assert len(graph_confirmation) == 10 and all(r['status'] == 'passed' for r in graph_confirmation)
for run in graph_confirmation:
    assert len(run['result']['samples']) == 2
    for sample in run['result']['samples']:
        assert sample['status'] == 'ok' and sample['spill_files_opened'] == 0
        for metric, millis in [('wall', sample['wall_seconds'] * 1000),
                              ('CPU', (sample['user_seconds'] + sample['system_seconds']) * 1000)]:
            label = f"memory graph / {sample['operation']} / {metric}"
            groups[('graph-confirmation', label)][run['variant']].append({'round': run['repetition'], 'milliseconds': millis})

for (suite, label), variants in groups.items():
    variants = {v: [x['milliseconds'] for x in sorted(values, key=lambda x: x['round'])] for v, values in variants.items()}
    assert all(len(values) == (5 if 'confirmation' in suite else 3) for values in variants.values())
    before, after = (statistics.median(variants[v]) for v in ('baseline', 'candidate'))
    pairs = [(a / b - 1) * 100 for b, a in zip(variants['baseline'], variants['candidate'])]
    rows.append({'suite': suite, 'label': label, 'baseline_ms': before, 'candidate_ms': after,
        'change_percent': (after / before - 1) * 100, 'paired_changes_percent': pairs,
        'median_paired_change_percent': statistics.median(pairs), 'process_values_ms': variants})
receipt = {'comparison': '69b025c..e121c66', 'sample_count': samples_count,
    'binaries': json.loads((out / 'binaries.json').read_text()),
    'execution': execution, 'summary': rows,
    'experiment_sources': {name: {'sha256': hashlib.sha256((out / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'content': (out / name).read_text()} for name in ('collection-probe.rs', 'build.py', 'run.py', 'summarize.py', 'boundary.py', 'confirm.py', 'confirm_graph.py')},
    'excluded_pilot': {'reason': 'Incomplete runtime calibration with 12 warm large-set iterations; terminated before a complete large-set result. All pilot samples excluded from comparison.',
        'log': (out / 'pilot-collection-baseline.log').read_text()},
    'boundary': boundary, 'confirmation': confirmation, 'graph_confirmation': graph_confirmation, 'results': raw}
(out / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
lines = ['| Workload | Before (ms) | After (ms) | Change | Paired changes |',
         '|---|---:|---:|---:|---|']
for row in rows:
    pairs = ', '.join(f'{p:+.1f}%' for p in row['paired_changes_percent'])
    lines.append(f"| {row['suite']}: {row['label']} | {row['baseline_ms']:.3f} | {row['candidate_ms']:.3f} | {row['change_percent']:+.1f}% | {pairs} |")
(out / 'summary.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
print('\n'.join(lines))
print(f'Validated {len(execution)} runs and {samples_count} result samples')
print('Also validated six boundary probes and 40 samples across 20 confirmation runs')

boundary.py.content:
"""Check the adjacent inline-collection boundary after the main paired run."""
import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

out = Path('/home/domen/dev/casita3/benchmarks/results/2026-09-08-statement-cache')
provenance = json.loads((out / 'binaries.json').read_text())
results = []
for repetition in range(1, 4):
    order = ('baseline', 'candidate') if repetition % 2 else ('candidate', 'baseline')
    for variant in order:
        name = f'boundary-{repetition}-{variant}'
        command = [str(out / f'{variant}-probe'), 'metadata::sqlite::tests::benchmark_statement_cache_collection', '--exact', '--ignored', '--nocapture']
        env = {**os.environ, 'CASITA_COLLECTION_COUNTS': '65536', 'CASITA_COLLECTION_ITERATIONS': '2'}
        print('START ' + name, flush=True)
        started = time.monotonic()
        load_before = os.getloadavg()
        with (out / f'{name}.log').open('w') as log:
            subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=600)
        output = (out / f'{name}.log').read_text()
        assert output.count('1 passed') == 1
        samples = [json.loads(line.removeprefix('collection_sample ')) for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith('collection_sample ')]
        assert len(samples) == 1 and samples[0]['count'] == 65536
        results.append({'variant': variant, 'repetition': repetition, 'command': command,
            'revision': provenance[variant]['revision'], 'status': 'passed', 'load_before': load_before,
            'load_after': os.getloadavg(), 'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - started,
            'completed_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(), 'sample': samples[0]})
        (out / 'boundary.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(f"PASSED {name} ({results[-1]['elapsed_seconds']:.1f}s)", flush=True)
